spec.reason: A stable reference improves the older semantic transport without a class selector, but the previous earlier reference and shared Q/K/V replacement disturbed native behavior. Measure a possible constant insertion in block23 attention, so only the last MLP follows it.
spec.collection: Incoming block23 residual, all fourteen head value outputs before O23, raw post-attention residual before the last MLP RMSNorm, and the normalized last-MLP input as a replay check.
spec.next_coordinate_selection_rule: For each of the128 shared value coordinates, compute the actual sum of its seven head-output contributions and select the smallest mean squared contribution on earlier factual fit states plus native states. No generation-based coordinate search.
spec.parent_weights: Frozen progress_carrier_weights.py only; no selector or reference applied.
